name: warp-session-restore
description: Restart your Claude Code sessions in Warp exactly as they were: a hook snapshots Warp's windows, tab groups (name, color, collapsed, pinned), tab colors and pane splits from Warp's own state, with the Claude session each pane runs; after a reboot, restore reopens that layout as a Warp launch configuration, each Claude pane resuming its session in place. macOS and Linux.
